# W5-001 — Choose animation engine boundary

- Phase: W5
- Status: `done`
- Priority: P1
- Role: architect
- Dependencies: W0-006, W1-007
- Parallel group: serial
- Risk: low
- Human approval required: true

## Objective

Audit existing Motion dependency in Board and choose CSS/SVG/Motion first; adapter seams for specialist character SDKs.

## Scope hints

- `apps/board/package.json`
- `packages/ui/package.json`

## Deliverables

- Decision record and dependency/licensing matrix.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Use existing motion package where capable.
- [x] Do not add GSAP/Rive/Live2D/Three/Pixi by default.
- [x] Paid/proprietary SDK requires explicit human approval.
- [x] No runtime dependency is added to assets package.

## Verification

- `dependency graph review`
- `bundle baseline`

## Completion record

- Commands / exit codes:
  - `user approval in chat; dependency source search` — exit 0
  - `pnpm ui:budget` — exit 0
- Evidence paths:
  - `MWXV_ULTRA_COMPLETE_VISUAL_UNIVERSE_AUTONOMOUS_PACK/evidence/motion-boundary-proposal.md`
  - `catalog JavaScript and stylesheet remain within declared raw/gzip budgets`
- Commit SHA: c92b1bce67534eb7196246e9c6068efac0a14a11
- Reviewer decision: Acceptance evidence recorded.
- Residual issues: Approved by user in chat on 2026-11-22 (Asia/Jakarta): use CSS/SVG-first scene implementation, retain the existing Motion dependency without using it absent measured need; do not add another runtime dependency.

## Notes

Keep this task atomic. Do not expand into unrelated refactors.
